errors.text_span: four bars representing different methods: Dapo+Self-reflection (blue), Dapo (light blue), SRPO (orange), and PPO+Self-reflection (green)
errors.evidence: The description lists only four methods and misassigns colors/patterns. The figure shows six bars with the following: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue with diagonal stripes), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (green with diagonal stripes).
The description omits the GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes) and PPO (green with diagonal stripes) methods entirely.
